# QuizBuffet

> Free, no-account practice tests for IT, cybersecurity, cloud, healthcare, trades, and finance certifications. Domain-by-domain quizzes with instant feedback and progress tracking saved locally in the browser. Last updated 2026-05-08.

## Available certifications
- [CompTIA Cloud+ (CV0-004)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-cloud-plus/): Cloud infrastructure skills for engineers and sysadmins 1200+ questions.
- [CompTIA ITF+ (FC0-U61)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-itf-plus/): IT fundamentals for beginners and career changers 1900+ questions.
- [CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-003)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-cysa-plus/): Threat detection and incident response for security analysts 1600+ questions.
- [CompTIA PenTest+ (PT0-003)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-pentest-plus/): Penetration testing and vulnerability management for security professionals 2160+ questions.
- [CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1101)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-a-plus-core-1/): Hardware, networking, and troubleshooting for IT support technicians 2100+ questions.
- [CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-a-plus-core-2/): Operating systems, security, and troubleshooting for IT support technicians 3200+ questions.
- [CompTIA Network+ (N10-009)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-network-plus/): Core networking skills for IT infrastructure professionals 1119+ questions.
- [CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-security-plus/): Core security skills for IT professionals defending enterprise environments 1900+ questions.
- [CompTIA Data+ (DA0-002)](https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-data-plus/): Data acquisition, analysis, and governance for data-driven decision making 1000+ questions.
- [Cisco CCNA (200-301)](https://quizbuffet.com/cisco-ccna/): The industry-standard entry into network engineering careers 800+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-cloud-practitioner/): Foundational AWS knowledge for technical and non-technical professionals 400+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-solutions-architect-associate/): The most popular cloud certification for designing AWS workloads 600+ questions.
- [AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-ai-practitioner/): Foundational AI, ML, and generative-AI knowledge for the AWS Cloud 500+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-ml-engineer-associate/): Build, deploy, and operate ML solutions on AWS 500+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-genai-developer-professional/): Build, integrate, and operate production GenAI solutions on AWS 688+ questions.
- [AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate (SOA-C03)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-cloudops-engineer-associate/): Deploy, manage, and operate workloads on AWS 500+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate (DEA-C01)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-data-engineer-associate/): Implement, monitor, and optimize data pipelines on AWS 500+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Developer – Associate (DVA-C02)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-developer-associate/): Develop, deploy, and debug cloud-based applications on AWS 500+ questions.
- [AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (DOP-C02)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-devops-engineer-professional/): Provision, operate, and manage distributed systems on AWS at scale 600+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C03)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-security-specialty/): Secure AWS workloads end-to-end: detection, identity, data protection, and governance 600+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty (ANS-C01)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-advanced-networking-specialty/): Design, implement, manage, and secure AWS and hybrid networks at scale 480+ questions.
- [AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)](https://quizbuffet.com/aws-solutions-architect-professional/): Design optimized AWS solutions across organizations using the Well-Architected Framework 600+ questions.
- [Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)](https://quizbuffet.com/microsoft-az-900/): Foundational Azure knowledge for cloud beginners and decision-makers 312+ questions.
- [Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)](https://quizbuffet.com/microsoft-az-104/): Day-to-day administration of Azure infrastructure at the associate level 500+ questions.
- [Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)](https://quizbuffet.com/isc2-cissp/): The gold-standard senior cybersecurity certification 800+ questions.
- [ITIL 4 Foundation (ITIL 4)](https://quizbuffet.com/itil-foundation/): The most widely adopted IT service management framework 400+ questions.
- [OSHA 10-Hour Construction (OSHA 10)](https://quizbuffet.com/osha-10-construction/): Required entry-level safety training for construction workers 400+ questions.
- [OSHA 30-Hour Construction (OSHA 30)](https://quizbuffet.com/osha-30-construction/): Supervisor-level construction safety certification 600+ questions.
- [Forklift Operator Certification (OSHA 1910.178)](https://quizbuffet.com/forklift-certification/): Required certification for operating powered industrial trucks 300+ questions.
- [CDL Class A (CDL-A)](https://quizbuffet.com/cdl-class-a/): Federal license required to drive tractor-trailers and large combination vehicles 300+ questions.

QuizBuffet content is free to read and reference. Practice questions are authored for this site. When citing, link to the cert page (e.g., https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-security-plus/) rather than copying long passages.
